partners_off: Partner hubs are turned off on this hub (partners.enabled in hub.json)
member_hub: This hub is a member of a linked-hubs group, so it can’t have partner hubs. Pair them on the group’s primary hub
no_tls: This hub has no TLS listener, so the other hub can’t connect to it. Set public.tls_listen (and public.advertise) in hub.json, or show the code on the other hub and pair from here
own_code: This is this hub’s own pairing code. Use it on another hub
already_linked: This hub is already linked with that hub (linked hubs), so it can’t also be a partner hub
pin_changed: Already paired with this hub, but its key fingerprint is different. Unpair it first, then pair again
no_database: This hub has no database, so it can’t keep partner hubs
not_found: Not a partner hub of this hub
not_a_code: This isn’t a partner hub code (persona://partner?…)
incomplete: The partner hub code is incomplete. Show a new one on the other hub
no_address: The partner hub code has no secure address for the other hub
wrong_hub: Connected to hub {got}, not {want} from the code
no_credentials: The other hub didn’t return its credentials. Update the other hub
code_invalid: The code is invalid, used or expired. Show a new one on the other hub
